clue.text: He felt rag trade improper for member of royal family

indicators.note: something improper is not in its proper order, so the preceding letters are rearranged

parts.note: fourteen letters taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone thinks the fashion business is beneath the dignity of a royal.
explanation.walkthrough: Alfred the Great was a 9th-century king of Wessex, so he counts as a member of an English royal family.
explanation.definitionFit: The Anglo-Saxon king Alfred belonged to the ruling house of Wessex, so he is one royal among many.

clue.text: Working with fake news primarily getting everybody upset in seaside resort

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the whole string is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a machine that is working is on
a dud is a fake or useless thing

indicators.note: primarily points to the first letter of the word before it

parts.note: first letter of news
everybody is all

explanation.surface: Fake news is causing upset in a seaside town.
explanation.walkthrough: Llandudno is a seaside resort on the north coast of Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Llandudno is a Victorian holiday town on the Welsh coast, an example of a seaside resort.

clue.text: Hanky-panky in rear hole

parts.note: the rump is the hindquarters
the letter O is shaped like a hole

explanation.surface: A saucy, Carry On style hint at mischief in someone's backside.
explanation.walkthrough: Rumpo is British slang, familiar from the Carry On films, for sexual activity.
explanation.definitionFit: Hanky-panky is a coy word for sexual misbehaviour, and rumpo is a jokey British slang synonym.

clue.text: Days out drinking cola leads to indigestion

indicators.note: drinking means taking something inside, so one piece holds the other
out here means wrong or disordered, so the letters before it are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
Pepsi is a brand of cola

explanation.surface: Days out spent drinking fizzy pop end in a stomach ache.
explanation.definitionFit: Dyspepsia is the medical term for indigestion, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Hollywood actor, it's appreciated, has no time

indicators.note: has no says a letter is missing from the word before

parts.note: you say thanks when something is appreciated
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A busy film star is praised but has no time to spare.
explanation.definitionFit: Tom Hanks is a famous film star, so he is an example of a Hollywood actor.

clue.text: Little by little, guard irritated colleague

indicators.note: someone irritated is ruffled or stirred up, so these letters are disturbed into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
an ally is a colleague or partner

explanation.surface: A sentry gets steadily more annoyed with a fellow worker.
explanation.definitionFit: Gradually means by small degrees, the same idea as an idiom about a little at a time.

clue.text: Put up before court

parts.note: ere is an old word for before
CT is the abbreviation for court

explanation.surface: Someone is brought up in front of a judge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put up before court' reads like being tried, but 'Put up' is the definition, as in building something.
explanation.definitionFit: To erect a building or tent is to put it up, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Altered rocking lever

indicators.note: rocking means shaking about, so the letters of the word before it are shaken into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A lever has been modified so that it rocks back and forth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Altered' looks like the anagram signal, but it is the fodder; 'rocking' does the shuffling.
explanation.definitionFit: A treadle is a foot-operated lever, as on a sewing machine or potter's wheel.

clue.text: Picked up deliveries in moors

indicators.note: picked up means heard, as on a radio, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: deliveries of babies are births

explanation.surface: Parcels are collected out on the open moorland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moors' looks like the noun for open heathland, but it is the verb for tying up a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship that moors ties up at a quay, which is what a vessel that berths does: a verb synonym.

clue.text: Somehow earn millions to provide weapons

indicators.note: somehow suggests an unspecified way of arranging, so the next word's letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
M is the abbreviation for million

explanation.surface: An arms dealer makes a fortune supplying weapons.
explanation.definitionFit: Enarm is an archaic verb meaning to arm, that is to equip with weapons.

clue.text: Soprano inspires European and Sri Lankan

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for soprano
to inspire is to breathe in
E is the abbreviation for European

explanation.surface: A singer is an inspiration to a European and to someone from Sri Lanka.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inspires' looks like encourages, but it is used in its literal sense of drawing breath in.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sinhalese are the majority ethnic group of Sri Lanka, so a Sinhalese person is Sri Lankan.

clue.text: Little European amphibian

definitions.note: a tadpole is a young amphibian, a larva

parts.note: a tad is a little bit
a Pole is a European from Poland

explanation.surface: A small frog or newt found in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: A tadpole is the larval stage of a frog or toad, so it is a juvenile amphibian.

clue.text: Checked street, one I must escape

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street

indicators.note: a letter that must escape gets out of the word, so it is removed

parts.note: people who are one are united
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone inspects a road and decides to get away from it.
explanation.definitionFit: Stunted growth is growth that has been checked, held back or restricted.

clue.text: Edge edge edges ledge's edge

indicators.note: to edge something is to border it on both sides, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: a side is an edge

indicators.note: the edge of a word is its outermost letter, here the one at its start

parts.note: the first letter of ledge

explanation.surface: A deliberately absurd chain of the same word, like a tongue-twister.
explanation.walkthrough: The first Edge is a verb, to move sideways; the second is the noun side; edges means surrounds; ledge's edge is its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To sidle is to move sideways cautiously, just as to edge along is to creep forward bit by bit.

clue.text: Unionist in outburst over cut leads to banishment

indicators.note: in tells us one piece is placed inside the other
cut means something is removed from the word for outburst

parts.note: an explosion is an outburst
O is the cricket scorer's abbreviation for an over
U is the abbreviation for Unionist

explanation.surface: An angry Unionist politician blows up over cuts and is thrown out.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six balls, abbreviated O on the scorecard.
explanation.definitionFit: Expulsion is the act of forcing someone out, which is what banishment means.

clue.text: Doctor helps cure person who's gone here?

definitions.note: a cryptic way of naming the place where a dead person lies

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the next letters are tampered into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A GP helps treat patients, though some still end up in the grave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like the subject of the sentence, but it is a verb telling you to rearrange; 'gone' means dead.
explanation.definitionFit: A sepulchre is a tomb, the place where someone who has died is laid to rest.

clue.text: In advance, inflict pressure on most of French city to submit

indicators.note: most of means nearly all, so the final letter of the city is dropped

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for pressure
Reims is a city in Champagne
to pose a question is to submit it for consideration

explanation.surface: A French city is forced to submit under pressure applied ahead of time.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, pressure on the city means P is placed above it.
explanation.definitionFit: To preimpose is to impose beforehand, that is to force something on someone ahead of time.

clue.text: Gives head in toolshed with gymnastic manoeuvre

parts.note: to hand something over is to give it

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter, so only the opening letter is kept

parts.note: first letter of toolshed
and means with or plus

explanation.surface: Someone does something unexpected in a garden shed.
explanation.definitionFit: A handstand, balancing upside down on the hands, is a basic gymnastics move.

clue.text: Buffalo to leopard: "This shows I belong here"

indicators.note: to buffalo is to baffle or bewilder, so the following letters are thrown into confusion

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A buffalo tells a leopard that it has a rightful place here.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Buffalo' looks like an animal speaking, but it is the verb meaning to bewilder.
explanation.definitionFit: A doorplate bears the occupant's name, announcing that this house or office is theirs.

clue.text: Tie-breaker is to remove alcoholic drink?

parts.note: the prefix de- means to take away, as in de-ice
cider is an alcoholic drink made from apples

explanation.surface: A teasing question: is breaking a tie a matter of taking away someone's drink?
explanation.definitionFit: A decider is the extra game or match played to settle a contest that is level.

clue.text: Tugs in yard are new, Kelvin beginning to say

parts.note: Y is the abbreviation for yard
an are is a metric unit of area, abbreviated A
N is the abbreviation for new
K is the symbol for kelvin

indicators.note: beginning to points to the opening letter of the word that follows

parts.note: first letter of say

explanation.surface: Someone reports that the boats in a dockyard are new.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tugs' looks like a noun for boats in the yard, but it is the verb meaning pulls.
explanation.definitionFit: To yank is to pull sharply, so yanks and tugs are verb synonyms.

clue.text: Cut the supporting workers' basic pay, ultimately

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means placed underneath the rest
ultimately means in the end, so the last letter of each word is taken

parts.note: the final letters of workers', basic and pay
taken as written

explanation.surface: A demand to slash employees' minimum wage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cut' reads as a reduction in wages, but it is the verb meaning to mow.
explanation.definitionFit: To scythe is to cut grass or crops with a long curved blade, a specific kind of cutting.

clue.text: Company to expand to produce fantasy recreation

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company
to splay is to spread out

explanation.surface: A firm grows in order to make a fantasy game.
explanation.definitionFit: Cosplay is dressing up as characters from fantasy films or comics, a hobby or recreation.

clue.text: Remove small woody plant when temperature drops

indicators.note: when temperature drops, hot becomes cold, so the letter for hot is swapped for the letter for cold

parts.note: a shrub is a small woody plant

explanation.surface: A gardener digs out a bush once the weather turns cold.
explanation.walkthrough: H for hot is replaced by C for cold, the usual tap labels.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrub a plan is to cancel or remove it, a colloquial synonym.

clue.text: Gentile from the south in charge of Hindu philosophy

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming from the south means read upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: goy is a Yiddish word for a non-Jew
IC is the abbreviation for in charge

explanation.surface: A non-Jewish person leads a school of Indian thought.
explanation.definitionFit: Yoga is a Hindu philosophy and discipline, and yogic is its adjective.

clue.text: Kid inspired by former PM's dignity

indicators.note: something inspired by is breathed in by the other, so it sits inside it

parts.note: Theresa May was a UK Prime Minister
to kid is to joke or jest

explanation.surface: A child is motivated by an ex-Prime Minister's dignified bearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kid' looks like a child but is the verb to tease.
explanation.definitionFit: Majesty is stately grandeur, so it is close in sense to dignity.

clue.text: When following Trump, say, nearly becomes traitor

indicators.note: nearly means not quite all, so the last letter is cut
following says one piece comes after the other

parts.note: Judd Trump is an English snooker world champion, so Trump is an example of someone called Judd
as means when

explanation.surface: A political follower of Donald Trump turns traitor.
explanation.walkthrough: Trump is not the US president here but the snooker player Judd Trump.
explanation.definitionFit: Judas Iscariot betrayed Jesus, so his name is used for any betrayer.

clue.text: Weird revolutionary claiming making mistakes leads to bold action

indicators.note: claiming means taking hold of, so one piece goes around the other
revolutionary means turning round, so the word for weird is read backwards

parts.note: odd means weird
erring means making mistakes

explanation.surface: A strange radical's blunders end in a daring exploit.
explanation.definitionFit: Derring-do is heroic, daring deeds, so it means bold action.

clue.text: Provide a theory about extinction

indicators.note: about means around, so the words before it surround the letters wanted

parts.note: inside proviDE A THeory

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to explain why a species died out.
explanation.definitionFit: Extinction is the end of life for a species, so death is a near synonym.

clue.text: Biochemical component of bone decomposing includes evidence of osteitis, principally

parts.note: a rib is a bone

indicators.note: decomposing means breaking down, so the letters are broken up and reassembled

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: principally points to the first letter of each of the preceding words

parts.note: the first letters of evidence, of and osteitis

explanation.surface: A medical note on the breakdown of bone showing signs of inflammation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bone decomposing' reads as one phrase, but bone is RIB and decomposing works on the following letters; osteitis is inflammation of bone.
explanation.definitionFit: A ribonucleoside is a molecule of a base joined to ribose sugar, a building block of RNA.
